title: Best Music Lesson Studio Software (2026): Prices Compared
description: Duet, mySymphony, My Music Staff, Fons and Teach 'n Go compared on published prices, scheduling, autopay, invoicing and parent portals for music teachers.
body:
Private piano, voice and instrument teachers mostly need the same four things: a recurring lesson calendar with make-ups, invoices or autopay so you aren't chasing parents, reminders, and somewhere families can see the schedule and pay. We compared five tools built for music lessons using only their own pricing pages. Anything a vendor doesn't publish is marked unknown.

{{table:duet,mysymphony,my-music-staff,fons,teach-n-go}}

Cost at a glance (published prices)

  • Duet: $9/mo or $99/yr flat, any studio size. Families pay a 1% transaction fee on digital payments, and card payments also carry 2.9% processing.
  • mySymphony: $0.25 per booked lesson, no monthly subscription, up to 100 active students. 80 lessons a month works out to $20.
  • My Music Staff: $16.95/mo including you, plus $4.95/mo for each additional teacher or staff member. Unlimited students.
  • Fons: $19.95/mo, no client or appointment limits. Card charges are 2.9% + $0.30, ACH is 1.8%, and there's 0.4% of subscription volume.
  • Teach 'n Go: $79/mo for up to 100 live students ($109/mo for Pro), priced in student bands up to 2,000.

Solo teacher on a budget

Duet has the lowest flat subscription we found at $9/mo, with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and ACH payments and a Smart Scheduler that builds a season schedule from parents' availability. Note the 1% fee families see on each statement. If you teach part-time, mySymphony's $0.25 per booked lesson may cost less than any subscription. {{aff:duet|Visit Duet}} {{aff:mysymphony|Visit mySymphony}}

Autopay without manual invoicing

Fons positions automatic payments as “the end of invoicing” and is the only tool here that publishes all its processing fees. My Music Staff includes automatic invoicing, online payments via Stripe or PayPal, and late fee automation. {{aff:fons|Visit Fons}}

Studio with several teachers

My Music Staff adds $4.95/mo per teacher, with roles, permissions, per-teacher schedules and payroll tracking. Teach 'n Go includes unlimited teachers and student, parent and teacher portals on every plan, priced by live students instead of by teacher. {{aff:mymusicstaff|Visit My Music Staff}} {{aff:teachngo|Visit Teach 'n Go}}

What we couldn't confirm

Not published on vendor pages: annual prices for My Music Staff, Fons and mySymphony; Fons trial length, staff pricing and parent portal; mySymphony and Teach 'n Go payment processing rates and mySymphony attendance tracking; whether Teach 'n Go supports automatic recurring card charges; Duet's cancellation terms. We don't publish ratings.

faq: What is the cheapest music lesson studio software?

Of the published prices we checked, Duet is $9/mo or $99/yr flat (families pay a 1% transaction fee on digital payments), and mySymphony charges $0.25 per booked lesson with no monthly subscription for up to 100 active students.
Which music teacher software has autopay?

Fons advertises automatic payments with flexible billing options. My Music Staff lists automatic invoicing, online payments and late fee automation, mySymphony lists automated invoicing and billing, and Duet tracks what families owe and sends statements by text link.
Do these tools have a parent portal?

My Music Staff has a student portal with self-service scheduling, lesson notes and payment history. Teach 'n Go includes student, parent and teacher portals. mySymphony has a basic student dashboard. Duet sends statements by text link with no login needed. Fons doesn't describe a parent portal on its pricing page.

My Music Staff offers 30 days with no credit card, mySymphony 30 days with no credit card, Teach 'n Go 14 days with no credit card, and Duet says its subscription follows a 30-day free trial. Fons mentions a trial but doesn't publish its length.
How much does My Music Staff cost with more teachers?
My Music Staff is $16.95/mo, and each additional teacher or staff member adds $4.95/mo. Students are unlimited.
